source: 23. Why can a ZXNAME0000XZ system hallucinate even when the retriever returned the correct evidence? [Intermediate - Reliability] Correct retrieval solves only the evidence-access problem. The generator can still overlook the passage, misread a table, make an arithmetic or reasoning error, combine evidence incorrectly, follow an irrelevant neighboring passage, or prefer its parametric prior. It can also generate unsupported details around an otherwise supported core answer. This is why ZXNAME0001XZ evaluation frameworks separate context relevance from answer faithfulness/relevance/correctness rather than treating retrieval recall as the final metric. A useful debugging test is an oracle-context experiment: give the generator only known supporting evidence. If the answer still fails, retrieval is no longer the main bottleneck. Conversely, if the oracle context works but normal ZXNAME0002XZ fails, inspect parsing, retrieval, reranking, or packing. ZXNAME0003XZ can reduce some factual errors, but it does not remove the need to evaluate the generator as a reasoning and evidence-use component. [22][23][24]
zh: 23.为什么即使检索器返回了正确的证据，ZXNAME0000XZ系统也会产生幻觉？ [中级 - 可靠性] 正确检索仅解决证据访问问题。生成器仍然可能忽略该段落，误读表格，犯算术或推理错误，错误地组合证据，遵循不相关的相邻段落，或者更喜欢其参数先验。它还可以围绕其他受支持的核心答案生成不受支持的详细信息。这就是为什么 ZXNAME0001XZ 评估框架将上下文相关性与答案忠实性/相关性/正确性分开，而不是将检索召回视为最终指标。一个有用的调试测试是 Oracle 上下文实验：仅向生成器提供已知的支持证据。如果答案仍然失败，检索就不再是主要瓶颈。相反，如果 oracle 上下文工作但正常的 ZXNAME0002XZ 失败，请检查解析、检索、重新排序或打包。 ZXNAME0003XZ 可以减少一些事实错误，但它并不能消除将生成器评估为推理和证据使用组件的需要。 [22][23][24]
